notes_for_editor: The Weebly Rockview page gives only the name and 'Mackinac County', so nothing about build date, design, height, status, staffing or access is established. The coordinates in the brief (46.06844, -84.41774) were not checked. anyplaceamerica.com returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text, so its Rockview topo listing was not read. The National Historic Lookout Register lists seven Michigan lookouts and Rockview is not among them. A search snippet from the Eastern US Lookouts Daggett page names three Mackinac County towers (Moran, Maple Hill, Daggett) replaced by aerial detection in 1966; Rockview is not named in that snippet and that page was not fetched. The story is shorter than the 120-word floor because the sources are thin; the state context is included only as background.
